description: "Find a doctor / clinician / physician by name" / "look up NPI for [provider]" / "verify a doctor's credentials" / "what's [Dr. X]'s NPI" — search the NPPES National Provider Identifier registry for individual US healthcare providers (~5M entries). Returns NPI numbers + provider names. terms can be a name fragment, NPI, or specialty. Use ef to include address, specialty, gender.

count.description: Maximum matches to return. Default 7, max 500. Use 1–3 for typeahead UX, 20–50 for browsing.

df.description: Comma-separated display fields to use in the `displays` array. Default varies per table; usually the canonical name.

ef.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include per match. Known fields: name.first,name.last,addr_practice.full,licenses.taxonomy.classification.

terms.description: Search query — prefix/contains match against canonical names. Whitespace-split into AND tokens. Example: "smith pediatrics".

name: npi_individual
title: Npi Individual
